digest.component_or_area: fsck command utilities and store layer
propositions: Filesystem primitives _resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, and _dir_is_archived are defined in fsck_repair.py but have no semantic relationship to repair operations and are imported by seven production modules.

Seven consumer modules currently import shared filesystem primitives from fsck_repair.py (either directly or via fsck.py re-export) creating an inverted dependency from store layer to command-layer repair module.

Move the three primitives from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py (a stdlib-only leaf module) to resolve the circular-dependency inverted relationship and eliminate the need for cross-layer imports from repair.

Maintain two compatibility surfaces across the refactoring: fsck.py re-exports (bound by four test files) and fsck_repair module-level bindings (bound by three test files patching _ticket_dirs and _resolve_tracker_git_dir as module attributes).
